info.title: sqlforge
info.description:
CLI tool for SqlForge — version-controlled typed stored procedures
      for MSSQL with Dapper codegen and AI context generation.
      Install: dotnet tool install -g SqlForge.Cli
      Usage:   sqlforge sync | generate | diff | annotate

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: SqlForge — version-controlled typed stored procedures for MSSQL

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Pull stored procedures from DB, detect changes, bump versions

options.name: --note
options.description: Optional change note recorded in version history

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate Dapper wrappers (Procedures.g.cs) and AI context (context.md)

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Show what has changed since last sync without writing anything

commands.name: annotate
commands.description: Add a human description to a stored procedure

commands.name: init
commands.description: Create a sqlforge.config.json in the current directory

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all tracked stored procedures from the registry
